messages:
mike_infra: Heads up — planning a midday maintenance window tomorrow for staggered BMC firmware updates + a sustained throughput verification run across the gpu-pool-4 cohort. Goal: apply BMC microcode, validate NVMe and network stability under load, then roll back if we see >3% tail-latency regressions. :hammer:

sara_sre: ack. what's the cadence? how many nodes at once?

mike_infra: We'll cordon 2 nodes per rack in 10m cohorts, so ~4 nodes concurrently (two racks). Total cohort run ~3h incl validation and warmup. No full rack drains.

ton y_oncall: @mike_infra can we run the sustained test against a mirror pool so customer traffic doesn't hit it? Concerned about Dedicated tenants on pool-4.

mike_infra: good call. We'll route active Dedicated to pool-4-backfill (reserved spare capacity) during the window. Policy: limited to 20% of reserved capacity; ops will watch quota.

natalie_prod: any SLA impact to call out for customer comms? I can squash into the status update if there's anything >5m expected interruption.

mike_infra: No expected interruption. We expect brief task evictions on the two cordoned nodes only; system autoscheduler will reschedule. If evictions cause >5min disruption for any tenant, infra-bot will trigger oncall alert.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: start=2026-03-21T16:00Z, duration=3h, change_id=CHG-20260321-091. Notifying oncall. :white_check_mark:

sara_sre: test plan? share the validation commands please.

mike_infra: Test plan (abbrev):
- Pre-check: nodestate & thermal: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-pool-4 -o wide`
- Cordon + drain (cohort): `kubectl cordon gpu-node-42 && kubectl drain gpu-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120`
- Apply BMC update via salt: `salt -G "bmc:pool=gpu-pool-4" state.apply bmc.firmware --target=gpu-node-42`
- Warm KV cache and run throughput: `run-eval --profile=throughput --duration=10m --clients=16`
- Network test (iperf3): `iperf3 -c 10.1.5.21 -P 8 -t 60`
- Collect metrics: `promql: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))`

mike_infra: We'll abort the cohort if 99th p95/p99 increases >3% absolute or if packet-loss >0.5% measured by iperf.

ton y_oncall: What about KV-cache cold-start impact to latency for small requests (prefix cache)? Need a pre-warm step.

mike_infra: Yep — run prefix cache warm: `cache-warm --prefixes=/prod/critical --concurrency=8 --duration=5m` before uncordon. We'll also run a small canary of real traffic replay for 10 minutes to assert quality.

natalie_prod: cost question — will backfill/reserved swap add notable billing? Finance asked if we push heavy load to spare capacity.

sara_sre: rough estimate: moving 20% reserved for 3h is negligible relative to monthly commit, but spot backfill might spike short-term. I'll DM finance with numbers after the window.

infra-bot: Alert rule check: maintenance window overlaps with scheduled patch in eu-west3 (ops/1769812345). No conflict detected for same pool.

mike_infra: ops timeline: 16:00Z cohort 1 (nodes 41-44) cordon->BMC->test->uncordon. 16:40Z cohort 2 (nodes 45-48). 17:20Z throughput sweep across mirror pool. 18:00Z debrief + tagging rollback snapshot if needed.

ton y_oncall: I'll be oncall. If anything >10% task loss we escalate and revert. :rotating_light:

sara_sre: I'll run the telemetry dashboards and watch p99, cpu throttling, and network tx errors. Quick checklist I'll snap into the runbook:
```
- confirm reserved backfill up
- run cache-warm
- run iperf3 baseline
- apply BMC to cohort
- run sustained throughput (10m)
- check p99 change <3%
- uncordon
- annotate nodes with firmware-version
```

mike_infra: Perfect. I'll drop the runbook link here: https://intranet/redwood/runbooks/bmc-maintenance (internal).

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled 30m before start.

natalie_prod: I'll add a short note in release notes: "Planned maintenance: BMC microcode + throughput validation. No expected downtime. Monitoring in place."

sara_sre: LGTM. see y'all tomorrow. :thumbsup:
